Lemma
[Extension of a partial frame]

↗ lem:ordered-linear-extension ↗ lem:open-linear-independence

If $(s_1,\ldots ,s_k)$ is a local $k$-frame of a rank-$m$ bundle over $u$, then $k\le m$ and each $x_0\in u$ has a neighborhood on which it extends to a smooth frame $(E_1,\ldots ,E_m)$ with $E_i=s_i$ for $i\le k$.
Proof

\sketch Trivialize near $x_0$, extend the fibre tuple by Lemma 5 to a basis, and define the extra sections to be constant in the trivialization. Lemma 5 shrinks the neighborhood so that the resulting $m$ sections remain a frame.

□
